boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain The University of Alabama
boards.description: Ten currently listed late-night food and convenience stops in Tuscaloosa, including an on-campus 24-hour market.

cards.title: Taco Bell on 15th Street
cards.subtitle: 236 15th Street, Tuscaloosa
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when you need a food stop after evening plans; the official location page lists service through 4 AM every day.
cards.short_summary: A 15th Street drive-thru with nightly hours listed through 4 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9 AM–4 AM daily at 236 15th Street.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru service daily until 4 AM; dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Stillman Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 2610 Stillman Boulevard, Tuscaloosa
cards.notes: Check the location page before heading out, then use this Stillman Boulevard stop for a late drive-thru or pickup order.
cards.short_summary: A Stillman Boulevard Taco Bell listed as open late until 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Tuscaloosa location directory lists the 2610 Stillman Boulevard restaurant open until 2 AM.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Tuscaloosa, Alabama
cards.access_notes: Official directory lists this location as open until 2 AM and identifies drive-thru, delivery, and Open Late service.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Skyland Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 815 Skyland Boulevard, Tuscaloosa
cards.notes: Plan a drive-thru or delivery order on Skyland Boulevard when campus-area options have closed; confirm service mode in the app.
cards.short_summary: A Skyland Boulevard Taco Bell with official late hours through 4 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Tuscaloosa location directory lists the 815 Skyland Boulevard restaurant open until 4 AM.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Tuscaloosa, Alabama
cards.access_notes: Official directory lists this location as open until 4 AM and identifies drive-thru, delivery, and Open Late service.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Highway 69 South
cards.subtitle: 9050 Highway 69 South, Tuscaloosa
cards.notes: Use the official ordering tools to check availability and arrange a late pickup from this Highway 69 South location.
cards.short_summary: A Highway 69 South Taco Bell listed as open until 1 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Tuscaloosa location directory lists the 9050 Highway 69 South restaurant open until 1 AM.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Tuscaloosa, Alabama
cards.access_notes: Official directory lists this location as open until 1 AM and identifies drive-thru, delivery, and Open Late service.

cards.title: Taco Bell on University Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 1211 University Boulevard, Tuscaloosa
cards.notes: Order ahead or walk over for a late food stop on University Boulevard; the location page lists dine-in service until 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A University Boulevard Taco Bell with official dine-in hours through 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists dine-in hours until 2 AM at 1211 University Boulevard on Thursday, with the location identified as Open Late.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1211 University Boulevard Dinner Hours
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Thursday dine-in hours from 10 AM–2 AM; verify other days before leaving.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Doris Pate Drive
cards.subtitle: 4900 Doris Pate Drive, Tuscaloosa
cards.notes: Use this Doris Pate Drive stop for a later drive-thru or delivery option, and check the official locator for day-specific changes.
cards.short_summary: A Doris Pate Drive Taco Bell officially listed as open until 1 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Tuscaloosa location directory lists the 4900 Doris Pate Drive restaurant open until 1 AM.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Tuscaloosa, Alabama
cards.access_notes: Official directory lists this location as open until 1 AM and identifies drive-thru, delivery, and Open Late service.

cards.title: Whataburger at McFarland & 13th
cards.subtitle: 1301 McFarland Boulevard East, Tuscaloosa
cards.notes: Use the official location listing to confirm holiday changes, then order at this McFarland Boulevard restaurant at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A Whataburger location whose official listing shows 24-hour operation.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists its McFarland & 13th location at 1301 McFarland Boulevard East as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location directory lists 24-hour operation daily and notes that holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: McDonald's on 12th Street
cards.subtitle: 2502 12th Street, Tuscaloosa
cards.notes: Check the restaurant and drive-thru listings before you go; both have late service windows, with Friday and Saturday running later.
cards.short_summary: A 12th Street McDonald’s with official hours through 2 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 5 AM–2 AM on Friday and Saturday at 2502 12th Street.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 1 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Subway at Pilot Travel Center #76
cards.subtitle: 4416 Skyland Boulevard East, Tuscaloosa
cards.notes: Use the Skyland Boulevard East address for a 24-hour sandwich stop; place a pickup or delivery order if those services fit your plans.
cards.short_summary: A Subway inside Pilot Travel Center #76 with official 24-hour store hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway lists its Pilot Travel Center #76 restaurant at 4416 Skyland Boulevard East as open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists store hours as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: SEC Market
cards.subtitle: 300 Hackberry Lane #1403, University of Alabama
cards.notes: Keep this on-campus market in mind for packaged snacks, drinks, and Fresh2Go items when a late study session extends past dining hours.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus market that Bama Dining lists as open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Bama Dining lists SEC Market at 300 Hackberry Lane #1403 as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Bama Dining lists SEC Market as open 24 hours, all day, Monday through Sunday.
